text: The change-event schema can contain fields the subscriber cannot access. Schema membership therefore must not serve as the application’s field authorization allowlist. (low confidence)
keywords: Shared case-alert authorization and sensitive-data minimization

text: The Open WebUI advisory supplies a concrete cross-product failure example: a JWT revoked by sign-out or back-channel logout could still authenticate new realtime connections. This supports testing realtime revocation separately from HTTP; it is not evidence of a Salesforce vulnerability. (low confidence)
keywords: Shared case-alert authorization and sensitive-data minimization

text: Security boundary caveat: Salesforce evaluates filter expressions even against fields the subscriber cannot access. Do not treat a matching filtered stream as proof that its predicate fields are authorized for the recipient. This caveat concerns authorization, not filter configuration. (low confidence)
keywords: Shared case-alert authorization and sensitive-data minimization

text: Design inference: check each recipient’s Case read access before fan-out and again for alert history and details. Collector visibility alone does not establish recipient authorization: CDC ignores sharing, whereas record sharing normally limits which records a user can view. (medium confidence)
keywords: Shared case-alert authorization and sensitive-data minimization

text: CDC checks field permissions for the subscribed user before delivery. In a shared collector, this protects the collector’s subscription; it does not establish the field permissions of each downstream alert recipient. The latter is a design inference requiring a separate recipient policy. (low confidence)
keywords: Shared case-alert authorization and sensitive-data minimization

text: Design recommendation by analogy to Apache Superset’s notification policy: put only context-free change nudges on a shared broadcast scope; keep Case text and sensitive state out of that scope. Superset expressly prohibits sensitive or authoritative broadcast state. This is supporting engineering precedent, not a Salesforce guarantee. (low confidence)
keywords: Shared case-alert authorization and sensitive-data minimization

text: For long-lived alert connections, revalidate authorization beyond connection establishment and handle session expiry. OWASP requires closing expired-session sockets; the WebSocket authentication guide warns against trusting a handshake indefinitely. Apply this principle to recipient access changes as a design requirement. (medium confidence)
keywords: Shared case-alert authorization and sensitive-data minimization

text: For the alert service, redact message payloads and credentials from logs. OWASP’s WebSocket guidance explicitly excludes complete messages, authentication tokens, session IDs, and personal information from logging. (low confidence)
keywords: Shared case-alert authorization and sensitive-data minimization
